articles.text: In White’s apartment, José, Carmen and John discuss Carmen’s job. She says she now works for National Airlines but used to work in an office where she wasn’t paid enough. José remarks that if the job didn’t suit her, she did well to leave it. Carmen admits it was difficult to tell her kind boss. The conversation shifts when Harris invites them to visit the Air Mission, but Carmen can’t go because she has to go shopping with Mrs. Harris. They decide to postpone the visit to the following Saturday.
